answer: Require each agent to post a violet-tagged stake deposit before it can join a summit of shared work, with the stake locked until a later verification round. Each identity is a vertex in a reputation graph: neighbors only vouch after the agent completes paid, checkable tasks, and a failed audit burns the stake and severs its edges. An attacker must therefore fund a real deposit and real work for every fake identity, so creating thousands of Sybils costs thousands of stakes instead of one script.
